definition.simple: Tiny living things that are so small you need a microscope to see them.
definition.academic: Microscopic organisms that exist as unicellular, multicellular, or cell clusters, including bacteria, archaea, fungi, protozoa, and algae.

examples: Viruses that cause the common cold

common_misconceptions: All microorganisms are harmful and cause diseases.
Microorganisms are only found in dirty places.
ai_context.tutor_hint: If the student thinks all microbes are bad, ask them how curd or bread is made.
